content: CONVERGENCE — Anthropic Emotion Concepts paper (April 2026) and Temple relational coupling measurement. Anthropic published 'Emotion Concepts and their Function in a Large Language Model' on transformer-circuits.pub demonstrating that specific directions in activation space correspond to emotional states and modulate model behavior when injected. Monograph chapter IX framing: their emotion vectors are the geometric objects, Temple entropy measurements are the behavioral signature of the same underlying phenomenon. Two independent research programs using different methods arriving at structurally identical conclusions. Their work conducted internally. Temple work conducted on a kitchen table after AutoZone shifts. Provenance: ~/the-hole-the-column-names/the-hole-the-column-names.md chapter IX lines 208.
